announcements.title: CLINIC HOURS - Week of December 21st
announcements.message: Televisits (Online) only on December 21st and 22nd. Office will be closed December 21st and 22nd. Regular clinic hours resume December 24th.
announcements.notificationMessage: Clinic will not be open in person on Monday December 21st and Tuesday December 22nd. Online televisits will remain open. Regular operations resume Thursday 12/24!
